Info

Defines AxisMask enumeration representing robot axis bitmasks.

class scaralang.core.model.motor.axis_mask.AxisMask(value, names=<not given>, *values, module=None, qualname=None, type=None, start=1, boundary=None)[source]¶

Bases: IntEnum

Enumeration of bitmask flags indicating target robotic axes.

It defines:

attributes:
NONE - No axes selected (0x00).
J1 - Joint 1 / Base motor (0x01).
J2 - Joint 2 / Elbow motor (0x02).
Z - Linear vertical axis motor (0x04).
J4 - Wrist rotation motor (0x08).
ALL - All 4 SCARA axes (0x0F).
ALL = 15¶
J1 = 1¶
J2 = 2¶
J4 = 8¶
NONE = 0¶
Z = 4¶
